name: PLA Military Pressure and Blockade/Invasion Risk
title: China–Taiwan · PLA Military Pressure and Blockade/Invasion Risk

definition.question: How intense is PLA military pressure on Taiwan and how close is it to a blockade or invasion?
definition.low_end: Routine peacetime PLA posture with minimal activity near Taiwan and no coercive exercises, incursions, or mobilization.
definition.high_end: Full-scale PLA invasion of Taiwan or comprehensive blockade cutting off Taiwan's air and maritime access is underway.

readings.rationale: No graded claims available to assess. Would be higher with evidence of large-scale joint exercises encircling Taiwan, sustained ADIZ incursions, amphibious mobilization, or blockade rehearsals; lower with evidence of routine, low-level patrol activity and no coercive signaling. Research needed on PLA exercises, sorties, naval deployments, and mobilization indicators.
